subject: pandora-everrest
label: Ten and a half, since Arc 6
note:
AND IT HAS BEEN TEN AND A HALF SINCE THE ARC SHE ASKED TO BE EMBODIED IN. Pandora requested her body in Arc 6 rather than wait the two years — partly so Jade would not be alone for them, partly for two extra years of cataloguing the sounds Jade makes. The figure the Archive carried was over an inch short of what she actually built, from the very first day she had a body at all.

It is not a growth and it is not an evolution. THE ARCHIVE JUST HAD THE WRONG NUMBER, and had it for the whole run.
